They won the 2007–08 [[Austrian Football First League]] and were promoted to the [[Austrian Bundesliga]]. The club was founded in 1919 as ''Kapfenberger SC''. The name of the team is often abbreviated to '''Kapfenberg'''. The club was renamed Kapfenberger SV in 1947 and currently play in the [[Austrian Football Second League|Austrian Second League]], the second level of Austrian football.
